visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of the Xinfeng Rest Area situated beneath a large concrete highway bridge structure. Numerous white and blue Bikonnect electric bicycles are lined up on a red-tiled sidewalk. A man in his 30s, wearing glasses and a grey polo shirt, stands centrally in the frame, gesturing towards the facilities behind him while speaking to the camera. The lighting is overcast and natural. (2) The camera cuts to various views of the parking area, which is expansive and sheltered by the bridge above. We see a close-up of a heavy-duty motorcycle equipped with black metal panniers, followed by a sequence showing white electric vehicle charging pedestals and colorful vertical signage displaying parking regulations and fine information. Cars and large shipping trucks are parked in the background under the grey concrete pillars. (3) The scene moves to the commercial zone, featuring the yellow "Nong Lian" storefront and the entrance to a FamilyMart convenience store. Inside, the camera captures rows of snacks, a steaming tray of tea eggs, and a variety of hot food options. A close-up shot shows a traditional sticky rice dumpling (Zongzi) wrapped in plastic alongside a white paper bowl of meatball soup with clear broth and green onions. (4) The narrator walks past outdoor wooden picnic tables towards a series of grey shipping containers converted into public restrooms. The interior of the men's restroom is shown, revealing clean, modern urinals against white tiles and wooden-textured stall doors. The space appears well-lit by overhead artificial lights and includes features like a baby changing station and multiple toilet stalls. (5) The final sequence returns to the bicycle parking area. A long, neat row of white electric bicycles with blue accents is showcased. Each bike has the "Bikonnect" logo clearly visible on the frame. The camera pans across the line of bikes under the bridge, emphasizing the availability of rental services for travelers.
